categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Liande Automatic Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: new semiconductor display intelligent equipment, automotive intelligent cockpit system equipment, semiconductor packaging and testing equipment, and new energy equipment. Their products include bonding, laminating, AOI inspection, film coating, and assembly line equipment for TFT-LCD, OLED, Mini/Micro LED displays, as well as semiconductor chip packaging and lithium battery manufacturing equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high vacuum curved surface lamination, material mechanics simulation, machine vision, multi-axis control, laser cutting/welding, high-speed and high-precision die bonding, flexible assembly, pulse/constant temperature hot pressing, and high-precision dispensing. They emphasize customized R&D driven by customer needs and industry foresight, with patented technologies in semiconductor die bonding and high-precision dispensing, and have developed equipment for AMOLED, Mini/Micro LED, Micro OLED, and lithium battery production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading semiconductor display panel manufacturers like BOE, Visionox, Tianma, and Huaxing Optoelectronics, as well as automotive electronics suppliers such as Continental Automotive Electronics, Bosch, and Visteon. The end markets served encompass consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, VR/AR/MR devices), automotive intelligent cockpits, semiconductor packaging and testing, and new energy sectors including lithium-ion battery production.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in South China, East China, Central China, North China, and Southwest China regions. It also has an expanding overseas presence with subsidiaries and sales in Europe (notably Romania), Southeast Asia, and North America, serving global customers and showcasing Chinese manufacturing capabilities internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Liande Automatic Equipment Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing specialized automated equipment used in the production and assembly of semiconductor display modules, semiconductor packaging and testing, and lithium battery manufacturing. They provide critical production equipment to downstream panel manufacturers and battery producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in new semiconductor display technologies such as AMOLED, Mini/Micro LED, and Micro OLED, expanding into front and mid-stage production equipment to break foreign monopolies. It invests heavily in R&D (8.65% of revenue) to develop high-precision bonding, lamination, dispensing, and assembly technologies. The firm also pursues intelligent manufacturing, digital transformation, and talent development to sustain competitive advantages and expand into semiconductor packaging and new energy equipment markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized automated equipment and solutions to manufacturers in semiconductor display, automotive electronics, semiconductor packaging, and lithium battery industries. The company follows a make-to-order production model, with sales recognized upon delivery, installation, and customer acceptance of equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in the semiconductor display equipment sector, especially in back-end module assembly equipment, competing with Japanese, Korean, and American firms that dominate front and mid-stage equipment. It has achieved breakthroughs in domestic substitution for high-generation AMOLED production lines and is expanding into semiconductor packaging and new energy equipment, positioning itself as a key player in China's industrial automation and semiconductor equipment market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.4 billion, a 15.63% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 243 million, up 37.06%. It maintains a solid asset base of RMB 2.8 billion with a net asset increase of 16.33%. The company has shown steady growth driven by market expansion and technological innovation, with a net asset return of 13.63% and ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, customized automation equipment with advanced proprietary technologies that meet the complex process requirements of new semiconductor display and lithium battery manufacturing. It offers superior cost-effectiveness compared to foreign competitors, rapid delivery, comprehensive after-sales service, and strong integration capabilities across production lines. Its focus on innovation and customer-centric solutions enables it to support domestic industry upgrades and global market expansion.
